LanguageData.RebuildUntilLegendary.ManualDeconstructT: When you deconstruct the tracked building yourself with the vanilla deconstruct order, the loop treats it as another attempt and places a fresh blueprint on the same spot. Turn this off to stop the loop instead when you deconstruct by hand (the toggle and the stop button always stop it).
LanguageData.RebuildUntilLegendary.AnyoneHaulsTip: When a specific builder is chosen, other colonists may still deliver materials to the restricted blueprint, filling it faster. The chosen builder always does all the actual construction work and rolls every quality.
LanguageData.RebuildUntilLegendary.StateOff: Off. Click to pick a target quality and builder.
LanguageData.RebuildUntilLegendary.TrainingModeDesc:
Cancels every frame of this rebuild at 99% work instead of finishing it. Vanilla refunds the frame's full material cost on cancel, and the builder keeps nearly all the construction experience earned, so each training cycle is almost free. No building is ever completed while this is on, so the target quality is never reached and the loop runs until you switch it off.
Note: on very cheap buildings a frame can slip past 99% and complete anyway - the normal loop then deconstructs it as usual.

LanguageData.RebuildUntilLegendary.DebugLoggingTip: Write every step of each rebuild loop to the log (activation, destruction, blueprint placement, quality rolls, completion). Only shown in developer mode.
LanguageData.RebuildUntilLegendary.VerboseLoggingTip: Additionally log high-frequency events such as every denied build attempt and every retry. Only useful for troubleshooting.
